name: Plus Two
source:
A year after Plus One, you and Darian are still going strong... and then a call comes that could change everything forever.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Plus_Two]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
《Plus One》的故事過去一年，你和達里安的感情仍然穩固……這時，一個電話打來，可能讓一切從此改變。
